name: Rotating Plank
instructions: Rotate onto one side into a side plank, arm reaching skyward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Keep the hips from sagging throughout. Dynamic core stability.
longevityNotes: A stable trunk protects the spine through every decade. Train the core for endurance and control rather than chasing burn.
overview: Rotating Plank is an intermediate core exercise targeting the abs, performed with just your bodyweight. A strong trunk stabilizes every lift and protects the spine in daily life.
